subject.statement: Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro.

summary: Verdict: TRUE (85% confidence) – Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro as of 2026‑10‑13. This assessment rests on the continued judicial hold of his bail money reported by a Montenegrin outlet in July 2026 and the absence of definitive evidence of his release or transfer to U.S. custody after March 2025, despite contrary reports of extradition and a 15‑year U.S. sentence.

findings.statement: Do Kwon, a South Korean national, is the co‑founder of Terraform Labs.
Do Kwon was extradited to the United States in March 2025 and sentenced to 15 years in prison in December 2025.
